I looked at both. Prototype B puts the tags down the side beside the cards, and clicking **Reading** there narrowed things exactly the same way as the buttons across the top did in A — so both do the job.

Between them, I'd go with B, the sidebar. As my collection grows I expect to have a lot of tags, and having them run down the side in a list feels like it'll hold up better than a row of buttons that'd wrap into a jumble. It also keeps them visible and out of the way of the cards. So let's use the sidebar version.
